early.context: Recruit toward this composition without disbanding useful veterans. Substitute an unavailable animal with a Warrior or Kossar until the relevant pool or building is ready.
notes: Before you copy the army
Each lord and hero uses a slot. Replace a troop when adding a hero. The supporting commander does not inherit Ostankya’s personal skill bonuses.
Manual-battle rhythm
Keep the human escort and reserve close enough to protect the hunters. Commit the beasts to selected fights; keep the witches out of sustained melee.
Unavailable starting specialists

The full opening muster is a practical early target, not a claim that every listed creature is in the starting army. Preserve whichever starting specialists you have; fill missing high-tier slots with affordable humans.
plan: Keep the identity
The hunters, witches and forest creatures are deliberate lasting parts of this force, not temporary mistakes to be replaced by an all-gun or all-monster stack.
Handle the weakness
Low armour and large bodies need careful matchups. Keep the health bars high before autoresolving difficult opponents.
